```{r}
# Load the ggplot2 package
library(ggplot2)

# Load the msleep dataset
data(msleep)
```
```{r}
# Create a scatterplot of total sleep versus bodyweight
plot(msleep$sleep_total, msleep$bodywt)
```

```{r}
# Create a scatterplot with total sleep on the y-axis and bodyweight on the x-axis
plot(msleep$sleep_total ~ msleep$bodywt)
```
```{r}
# Add labels to the x-axis and y-axis
plot(msleep$sleep_total ~ msleep$bodywt,
     pch = 16,
     col = "blue",
     bty = "L",
     xlab = "Bodyweight (grams)",
     ylab = "Total Sleep (hours)")
# Add a line of best fit using a linear model
abline(lm(msleep$sleep_total ~ msleep$bodywt))
```
```{r}
# Create an empty column named colors in the msleep dataframe
msleep$colors = NA

# Assign red to animals that sleep 17 hours or more
msleep$colors[msleep$sleep_total >= 17] <- "red"

# Assign black to animals that sleep less than 17 hours
msleep$colors[msleep$sleep_total < 17] <- "black"
```

```{r}
# Create a scatterplot with points colored by total sleep duration
plot(msleep$sleep_total ~ msleep$bodywt,
     pch = 16,
     col = msleep$colors,
     bty = "L",
     xlab = "Bodyweight (grams)",
     ylab = "Total Sleep (hours)")
```
```{r}
# Create a histogram of total sleep and use 10 rainbow colors
hist(msleep$sleep_total, col = rainbow(10))
```
```{r}
# Create a boxplot of total sleep across different animal orders
plot(msleep$sleep_total ~ as.factor(msleep$order), col = rainbow(19))
```
```{r}
# Create a boxplot of total sleep across different animal orders
boxplot(msleep$sleep_total ~ as.factor(msleep$order), col = rainbow(19))
```
```{r}
# Create a plot comparing total sleep across different types of consumers
plot(msleep$sleep_total ~ as.factor(msleep$vore),
     col = rainbow(4),
     xlab = "Bodyweight (grams)",
     ylab = "Total Sleep (hours)")
```
```{r}
# Load the states dataset
data(state)

# Convert the dataset into a dataframe
states = as.data.frame(state.x77)

# Examine the dataframe
str(states)

# Create an initial ggplot
ggplot(data=states)
```
```{r}
# Set the x and y variables using aes()
ggplot(data=states, aes(x=Population, y=Income)) +

# Add points to create the scatterplot
  geom_point()
```

```{r}
# Create a scatterplot of population versus income
ggplot(data=states, aes(x=Population, y=Income)) +

# Add blue points and adjust their size
  geom_point(color="blue", size=3)
```

```{r}
# Create a scatterplot and add a linear regression line
ggplot(data=states, aes(x=Population, y=Income))+geom_point()+geom_smooth(method="lm")
```

```{r}
# Create the scatterplot with a line of best fit and a minimal theme
ggplot(data=states, aes(x=Population, y=Income))+geom_point()+geom_smooth(method="lm")+theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
# Plot income against illiteracy, with points colored by population
ggplot(data=states, aes(x=Income, y=Illiteracy, color=Population)) +geom_point()+geom_smooth(method="lm", color="red")+theme_classic()
```
```{r}
# Convert vore to a factor to group and color animals by diet
ggplot(msleep, aes(y=sleep_total, x=sleep_rem, group=as.factor(vore), color=as.factor(vore))) +geom_point()
```
# Customize the sleep scatterplot with axis labels, a minimal theme, and diet colors

```{r}
# Add labels, change the theme, and customize the diet legend
ggplot(msleep, aes(y=sleep_total, x=sleep_rem, group=as.factor(vore), color=as.factor(vore)))+
  geom_point()+
  labs(y= "Total Sleep (hours)", x= "REM sleep (hours)")+
  theme_minimal()+
  scale_color_manual(name="Diet",
                     labels = c("Carnivore",
                                "Herbivore",
                                "Insectivore",
                                "Omnivore",
                                "NA"),
                     values = c("carni"="blue",
                                "herbi"="red",
                                "insecti"="green",
                                "omni"="brown",
                                "NA"="orange"))
```
# Assign the sleep scatterplot to an object called g

```{r}
# Assign the plot to an object
g<-ggplot(msleep, aes(y=sleep_total, x=sleep_rem, group=as.factor(vore), color=as.factor(vore)))+
  geom_point()+
  labs(y= "Total Sleep (hours)", x= "REM sleep (hours)")+
  theme_minimal()+
  scale_color_manual(name="Diet",
                     labels = c("Carnivore",
                                "Herbivore",
                                "Insectivore",
                                "Omnivore",
                                "NA"),
                     values = c("carni"="blue",
                                "herbi"="red",
                                "insecti"="green",
                                "omni"="brown",
                                "NA"="orange"))
g
```
```{r}
# Create a scatterplot grouped and colored by species
ggplot(iris, aes(y=Sepal.Length, x=Sepal.Width, group=Species, color=Species))+
  geom_point()+
  facet_wrap(~Species)+
  geom_smooth(method="lm")
```
```{r}
# Create a plot of chick weight over time grouped by diet
ggplot(ChickWeight, aes(x=Time, y=weight, group=Diet, color=Diet))+
  stat_summary(fun=mean, geom="point", size=1)+
  stat_summary(fun=mean, geom="line", size=1)+
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar",
               aes(width=0.1), size=0.5)
```
